items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (J.C. Higginbotham) does not speak in the provided transcript. The mention of Coot Anderson is made by the Interviewer, who states 'I've known Coot a long time.' There is no evidence of a personal relationship between the interviewee and Coot Anderson.

ctx.x: Jabbo Smith. Jabberwocky, he came from there.

Yes. One of the best. He played trombone and trumpet and played. He played down at the Small's and let's see who else. That's about all I remember. But, every kid that came out of their orphanage played.
Well, Coot Anderson came out of that orphanage.
